facts.fact: The Lesotho Internet Exchange Point (LIXP), hosted at the Lesotho Communications Authority in Maseru, was officially relaunched after a revamp reported on 2026-02-02, with the LCA saying it hosts five ISPs and two content delivery networks (unnamed); the exchange was founded in 2011, stopped, and resumed in 2016.

systems.platform: Ubiquiti USW-Pro switches and EdgeRouter Infinity routers
systems.owner: Lesotho Communications Authority (custodian); Internet Society Lesotho Chapter
systems.tiers: ISPs, higher education, government departments, banks

note: The two CDNs are not named, so no content fact.
